'''2024 Charity Joe Horbey DS TDIGWATT''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Joe Horbey]] at the [[2024 Online Retro Event for Charity]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Joe Horbey]]
* '''Event:''' [[2024 Online Retro Event for Charity]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Format:''' [[Classic (no v-cards)|Classic No-V]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further|ECC-D-thisdealisgettingworseallthetime.gif}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' [[Prepared Defenses]] · [[Twi'lek Advisor]]
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:2024-retro-24Retro Horbey DS TDIGWATT.txt|Download]]
